metadata.description: Generic Claude Code skills and agents for engineering and research teams, plus an opt-in plugin of comfort tools for neurodivergent users.

plugins.name: team
plugins.description: Engineering and research workflow skills (planning, debugging, review, research with citations, Anki decks and mind-maps, easy-read) and four subagents.

plugins.name: neurodivergent
plugins.description: Comfort tools for ADHD, autistic and dyslexic users: session status, goal pinning, calm-down and unstuck prompts, reflections, done/waiting notifications, and an nd-friendly output style. Works best alongside the team plugin.
